// This Pine Script® code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/ MPL-2.0
//@version=6
strategy("Asia + NY Positive Delta Strategy - Test Copy", "Asia + NY Delta Test", overlay = true, initial_capital = 100000, default_qty_type = strategy.fixed, default_qty_value = 1, pyramiding = 0, margin_long = 50, commission_type = strategy.commission.percent, commission_value = 0.041, process_orders_on_close = true, max_lines_count = 500)

// --- Constants ---
string TIMEZONE = "UTC"
int ASIA_OPEN_HOUR = 0
int DEFAULT_NY_OPEN_HOUR = 13
int HOLD_HOURS = 24
int HOUR_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000
float RISK_PER_TRADE_PCT = 3.0
float STOP_LOSS_PCT = 2.0
float FEE_PER_SIDE_PCT = 0.041
float INITIAL_CAPITAL = 100000.0
float DEFAULT_RETRACE_THRESHOLD_PCT = 2.5
int PERIOD_A_START = timestamp("27 Apr 2023 00:00 +0000")
int PERIOD_A_END = timestamp("05 Oct 2025 00:00 +0000")
int PERIOD_B_START = timestamp("06 Oct 2025 00:00 +0000")
int PERIOD_B_END = timestamp("30 Jun 2026 00:00 +0000")

// --- Inputs ---
measurementHoursInput = input.int(2, "Entry window (hours)", minval = 1, maxval = 23, tooltip = "Both Asia and NY signals are measured during this many hours after their session open.", group = "Strategy")
gainPctInput = input.float(1.5, "Positive delta trigger (%)", minval = 0.01, step = 0.1, tooltip = "Enter long when the session high reaches this percentage above that session's UTC open.", group = "Strategy")
nyOpenHourInput = input.int(DEFAULT_NY_OPEN_HOUR, "NY open hour (UTC)", minval = 1, maxval = 22, tooltip = "UTC hour used as the NY session open. NY trades exit at the next UTC midnight.", group = "Strategy")
volumeLengthInput = input.int(50, "Volume average length", minval = 1, tooltip = "The trigger bar volume must be at least this many bars' average volume.", group = "Volume Filter")
retraceThresholdInput = input.float(DEFAULT_RETRACE_THRESHOLD_PCT, "Maximum 2h retracement (%)", options = [1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0], tooltip = "At the end of the two-hour window, the trigger is rejected when the close has retraced at least this percentage from the two-hour peak.", group = "Retracement Filter")
startDateInput = input.time(timestamp("01 Jan 1970 00:00 +0000"), "Start date", tooltip = "Uses the earliest available chart history when left at the default.", group = "Date Range")
endDateInput = input.time(timestamp("31 Dec 2099 23:59 +0000"), "End date", tooltip = "The strategy can open trades up to and including this date and time.", group = "Date Range")
closeAtEndInput = input.bool(true, "Close at end of range", tooltip = "Closes any open position once the selected end date has passed.", group = "Date Range")
manualDateRangeInput = input.bool(false, "Enable manual date range", tooltip = "Off runs from the earliest available chart bar through the current live chart bar. Turn on to use the Start date and End date inputs.", group = "Date Range")
showStatsInput = input.bool(true, "Show strategy statistics", tooltip = "Displays statistics from the native strategy orders.", group = "Display")

// --- Risk-based sizing ---
calculatePositionSize(entryPrice, stopPrice, equity) =>
    riskCapital = math.max(equity, 0.0) * RISK_PER_TRADE_PCT / 100.0
    commissionRiskPerUnit = (entryPrice + stopPrice) * FEE_PER_SIDE_PCT / 100.0
    priceRiskPerUnit = entryPrice - stopPrice
    riskPerUnit = priceRiskPerUnit + commissionRiskPerUnit
    riskPerUnit > 0.0 ? riskCapital / riskPerUnit : 0.0

calculatePeriodTradeCount(startTime, endTime) =>
    int tradeCount = 0
    if strategy.closedtrades > 0
        for tradeNumber = 0 to strategy.closedtrades - 1
            tradeEntryTime = strategy.closedtrades.entry_time(tradeNumber)
            if tradeEntryTime >= startTime and tradeEntryTime < endTime
                tradeCount += 1
    tradeCount

calculatePeriodWinCount(startTime, endTime) =>
    int winCount = 0
    if strategy.closedtrades > 0
        for tradeNumber = 0 to strategy.closedtrades - 1
            tradeEntryTime = strategy.closedtrades.entry_time(tradeNumber)
            tradeEntryPrice = strategy.closedtrades.entry_price(tradeNumber)
            tradeExitPrice = strategy.closedtrades.exit_price(tradeNumber)
            tradeSize = strategy.closedtrades.size(tradeNumber)
            tradeCommission = strategy.closedtrades.commission(tradeNumber)
            tradeNetProfit = (tradeExitPrice - tradeEntryPrice) * tradeSize - tradeCommission
            if tradeEntryTime >= startTime and tradeEntryTime < endTime and tradeNetProfit > 0.0
                winCount += 1
    winCount

// --- Date range ---
dateRangeValid = not manualDateRangeInput or startDateInput <= endDateInput
inDateRange = not manualDateRangeInput or (dateRangeValid and time >= startDateInput and time <= endDateInput)
dateRangeEnded = manualDateRangeInput and dateRangeValid and time > endDateInput

// --- UTC sessions ---
dayId = year(time, TIMEZONE) * 10000 + month(time, TIMEZONE) * 100 + dayofmonth(time, TIMEZONE)
newDay = na(dayId[1]) or dayId != dayId[1]
barHour = hour(time, TIMEZONE)
asiaWindowActive = barHour >= ASIA_OPEN_HOUR and barHour < ASIA_OPEN_HOUR + measurementHoursInput
nyWindowActive = barHour >= nyOpenHourInput and barHour < nyOpenHourInput + measurementHoursInput

var float asiaOpen = na
var int asiaStartTime = na
var float asiaMeasurementHigh = na
var bool asiaTriggerReached = false
var bool asiaTradeTakenToday = false
var int asiaRawSignalCount = 0
var int asiaSignalCount = 0
var int asiaSkippedVolumeCount = 0
var int asiaEntryCount = 0
var bool asiaPendingTrigger = false
var bool asiaTriggerVolumeConfirmed = false
var int asiaMatrixPass15 = 0
var int asiaMatrixPass20 = 0
var int asiaMatrixPass25 = 0
var int asiaMatrixPass30 = 0

var float nyOpen = na
var int nyStartTime = na
var float nyMeasurementHigh = na
var bool nyTriggerReached = false
var bool nyTradeTakenToday = false
var int nyRawSignalCount = 0
var int nySignalCount = 0
var int nySkippedVolumeCount = 0
var int nyEntryCount = 0
var bool nyPendingTrigger = false
var bool nyTriggerVolumeConfirmed = false
var int nyMatrixPass15 = 0
var int nyMatrixPass20 = 0
var int nyMatrixPass25 = 0
var int nyMatrixPass30 = 0

var int entryTime = na
var int activeSession = 0
var string activeEntryId = ""
var float activeStopPrice = na
var float lastOrderQty = na
var line liveAsiaOpenLine = na
var line liveNyOpenLine = na
var line triggeredAsiaOpenLine = na
var line triggeredNyOpenLine = na

var simEquityArray = array.new_float(4, INITIAL_CAPITAL)
var simQtyArray = array.new_float(4, 0.0)
var simEntryPriceArray = array.new_float(4, na)
var simStopPriceArray = array.new_float(4, na)
var simEntryTimeArray = array.new_int(4, na)
var simSessionArray = array.new_int(4, 0)
var simClosedPnlArray = array.new_float(4, 0.0)
var simClosedCountArray = array.new_int(4, 0)
var simWinCountArray = array.new_int(4, 0)

if newDay
    asiaOpen := open
    asiaStartTime := time
    asiaMeasurementHigh := na
    asiaTriggerReached := false
    asiaTradeTakenToday := false
    asiaPendingTrigger := false
    asiaTriggerVolumeConfirmed := false
    nyOpen := na
    nyStartTime := na
    nyMeasurementHigh := na
    nyTriggerReached := false
    nyTradeTakenToday := false
    nyPendingTrigger := false
    nyTriggerVolumeConfirmed := false
    if not na(liveAsiaOpenLine)
        line.delete(liveAsiaOpenLine)
    liveAsiaOpenLine := line.new(x1 = asiaStartTime, y1 = asiaOpen, x2 = time_close, y2 = asiaOpen, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = color.new(chart.fg_color, 0), style = line.style_solid, width = 2)
    if not na(liveNyOpenLine)
        line.delete(liveNyOpenLine)
    liveNyOpenLine := na
else if not na(liveAsiaOpenLine)
    line.set_xy2(liveAsiaOpenLine, time_close, asiaOpen)

if barHour == nyOpenHourInput
    nyOpen := open
    nyStartTime := time
    nyMeasurementHigh := na
    nyTriggerReached := false
    nyPendingTrigger := false
    nyTriggerVolumeConfirmed := false
    if not na(liveNyOpenLine)
        line.delete(liveNyOpenLine)
    liveNyOpenLine := line.new(x1 = nyStartTime, y1 = nyOpen, x2 = time_close, y2 = nyOpen, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = color.new(#f59e0b, 0), style = line.style_solid, width = 2)
else if not na(liveNyOpenLine)
    line.set_xy2(liveNyOpenLine, time_close, nyOpen)

// --- Session signals, volume filter, and two-hour retracement filter ---
volumeAverage = ta.sma(volume, volumeLengthInput)
volumeConfirmed = not na(volumeAverage) and volume >= volumeAverage
asiaWindowClosing = not na(asiaStartTime) and time < asiaStartTime + measurementHoursInput * HOUR_MS and time_close >= asiaStartTime + measurementHoursInput * HOUR_MS
nyWindowClosing = not na(nyStartTime) and time < nyStartTime + measurementHoursInput * HOUR_MS and time_close >= nyStartTime + measurementHoursInput * HOUR_MS

bool asiaRawTrigger = false
if asiaWindowActive and not na(asiaOpen)
    asiaMeasurementHigh := na(asiaMeasurementHigh) ? high : math.max(asiaMeasurementHigh, high)
    asiaRawTrigger := inDateRange and not asiaTriggerReached and asiaMeasurementHigh >= asiaOpen * (1.0 + gainPctInput / 100.0)
    if asiaRawTrigger
        asiaPendingTrigger := true
        asiaTriggerVolumeConfirmed := volumeConfirmed
        asiaRawSignalCount += 1
    asiaTriggerReached := asiaTriggerReached or asiaRawTrigger

bool nyRawTrigger = false
if nyWindowActive and not na(nyOpen)
    nyMeasurementHigh := na(nyMeasurementHigh) ? high : math.max(nyMeasurementHigh, high)
    nyRawTrigger := inDateRange and not nyTriggerReached and nyMeasurementHigh >= nyOpen * (1.0 + gainPctInput / 100.0)
    if nyRawTrigger
        nyPendingTrigger := true
        nyTriggerVolumeConfirmed := volumeConfirmed
        nyRawSignalCount += 1
    nyTriggerReached := nyTriggerReached or nyRawTrigger

bool asiaTrigger = false
asiaRetracementPct = not na(asiaMeasurementHigh) ? 100.0 * (asiaMeasurementHigh - close) / asiaMeasurementHigh : na
if asiaWindowClosing and asiaPendingTrigger
    asiaTrigger := asiaTriggerVolumeConfirmed and asiaRetracementPct < retraceThresholdInput
    if asiaTrigger
        asiaSignalCount += 1
    else if not asiaTriggerVolumeConfirmed
        asiaSkippedVolumeCount += 1
    if asiaTriggerVolumeConfirmed
        if asiaRetracementPct < 1.5
            asiaMatrixPass15 += 1
        if asiaRetracementPct < 2.0
            asiaMatrixPass20 += 1
        if asiaRetracementPct < 2.5
            asiaMatrixPass25 += 1
        if asiaRetracementPct < 3.0
            asiaMatrixPass30 += 1

bool nyTrigger = false
nyRetracementPct = not na(nyMeasurementHigh) ? 100.0 * (nyMeasurementHigh - close) / nyMeasurementHigh : na
if nyWindowClosing and nyPendingTrigger
    nyTrigger := nyTriggerVolumeConfirmed and nyRetracementPct < retraceThresholdInput
    if nyTrigger
        nySignalCount += 1
    else if not nyTriggerVolumeConfirmed
        nySkippedVolumeCount += 1
    if nyTriggerVolumeConfirmed
        if nyRetracementPct < 1.5
            nyMatrixPass15 += 1
        if nyRetracementPct < 2.0
            nyMatrixPass20 += 1
        if nyRetracementPct < 2.5
            nyMatrixPass25 += 1
        if nyRetracementPct < 3.0
            nyMatrixPass30 += 1

// --- Virtual threshold simulations ---
asiaCandidateAtClose = asiaWindowClosing and asiaPendingTrigger and asiaTriggerVolumeConfirmed
nyCandidateAtClose = nyWindowClosing and nyPendingTrigger and nyTriggerVolumeConfirmed

for simIndex = 0 to 3
    simThreshold = simIndex == 0 ? 1.5 : simIndex == 1 ? 2.0 : simIndex == 2 ? 2.5 : 3.0
    simQty = array.get(simQtyArray, simIndex)
    simHadPosition = simQty != 0.0
    simClosedThisBar = false
    if simHadPosition
        simEntryPrice = array.get(simEntryPriceArray, simIndex)
        simStopPrice = array.get(simStopPriceArray, simIndex)
        simSession = array.get(simSessionArray, simIndex)
        simEntryTime = array.get(simEntryTimeArray, simIndex)
        simStopExit = low <= simStopPrice
        simTimeExit = (simSession == 1 and time_close >= simEntryTime + HOLD_HOURS * HOUR_MS) or (simSession == 2 and newDay)
        if simStopExit or simTimeExit
            simExitPrice = simStopExit ? simStopPrice : close
            simCommission = (math.abs(simEntryPrice * simQty) + math.abs(simExitPrice * simQty)) * FEE_PER_SIDE_PCT / 100.0
            simProfit = (simExitPrice - simEntryPrice) * simQty - simCommission
            array.set(simEquityArray, simIndex, array.get(simEquityArray, simIndex) + simProfit)
            array.set(simClosedPnlArray, simIndex, array.get(simClosedPnlArray, simIndex) + simProfit)
            array.set(simClosedCountArray, simIndex, array.get(simClosedCountArray, simIndex) + 1)
            if simProfit > 0.0
                array.set(simWinCountArray, simIndex, array.get(simWinCountArray, simIndex) + 1)
            array.set(simQtyArray, simIndex, 0.0)
            array.set(simEntryPriceArray, simIndex, na)
            array.set(simStopPriceArray, simIndex, na)
            array.set(simEntryTimeArray, simIndex, na)
            array.set(simSessionArray, simIndex, 0)
            simClosedThisBar := true
    simEntrySignal = not simHadPosition and not simClosedThisBar and ((asiaCandidateAtClose and asiaRetracementPct < simThreshold) or (nyCandidateAtClose and nyRetracementPct < simThreshold))
    if simEntrySignal
        simEntrySession = asiaCandidateAtClose ? 1 : 2
        simEntryPrice = close
        simStopPrice = simEntryPrice * (1.0 - STOP_LOSS_PCT / 100.0)
        simRiskCapital = math.max(array.get(simEquityArray, simIndex), 0.0) * RISK_PER_TRADE_PCT / 100.0
        simCommissionRiskPerUnit = (simEntryPrice + simStopPrice) * FEE_PER_SIDE_PCT / 100.0
        simRiskPerUnit = (simEntryPrice - simStopPrice) + simCommissionRiskPerUnit
        simOrderQty = simRiskPerUnit > 0.0 ? simRiskCapital / simRiskPerUnit : 0.0
        if simOrderQty > 0.0
            array.set(simQtyArray, simIndex, simOrderQty)
            array.set(simEntryPriceArray, simIndex, simEntryPrice)
            array.set(simStopPriceArray, simIndex, simStopPrice)
            array.set(simEntryTimeArray, simIndex, time_close)
            array.set(simSessionArray, simIndex, simEntrySession)

if asiaWindowClosing and asiaPendingTrigger
    asiaPendingTrigger := false
    asiaTriggerVolumeConfirmed := false
if nyWindowClosing and nyPendingTrigger
    nyPendingTrigger := false
    nyTriggerVolumeConfirmed := false

// --- Native strategy orders ---
if asiaTrigger and not asiaTradeTakenToday and strategy.position_size == 0
    stopPrice = close * (1.0 - STOP_LOSS_PCT / 100.0)
    orderQty = calculatePositionSize(close, stopPrice, strategy.equity)
    if orderQty > 0.0
        strategy.entry("Asia Long", strategy.long, qty = orderQty, comment = "Asia positive delta trigger")
        strategy.exit("Asia SL", from_entry = "Asia Long", stop = stopPrice, comment = "2% stop")
        entryTime := time_close
        activeSession := 1
        activeEntryId := "Asia Long"
        activeStopPrice := stopPrice
        lastOrderQty := orderQty
        asiaEntryCount += 1
        asiaTradeTakenToday := true
        triggeredAsiaOpenLine := line.new(x1 = asiaStartTime, y1 = asiaOpen, x2 = time_close, y2 = asiaOpen, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = color.new(chart.fg_color, 25), style = line.style_dotted, width = 1)

if nyTrigger and not nyTradeTakenToday and strategy.position_size == 0
    stopPrice = close * (1.0 - STOP_LOSS_PCT / 100.0)
    orderQty = calculatePositionSize(close, stopPrice, strategy.equity)
    if orderQty > 0.0
        strategy.entry("NY Long", strategy.long, qty = orderQty, comment = "NY positive delta trigger")
        strategy.exit("NY SL", from_entry = "NY Long", stop = stopPrice, comment = "2% stop")
        entryTime := time_close
        activeSession := 2
        activeEntryId := "NY Long"
        activeStopPrice := stopPrice
        lastOrderQty := orderQty
        nyEntryCount += 1
        nyTradeTakenToday := true
        triggeredNyOpenLine := line.new(x1 = nyStartTime, y1 = nyOpen, x2 = time_close, y2 = nyOpen, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = color.new(#f59e0b, 25), style = line.style_dotted, width = 1)

// --- Exit detection ---
stopExitThisBar = strategy.position_size > 0 and not na(activeStopPrice) and low <= activeStopPrice
asiaTimeExitDue = strategy.position_size > 0 and activeSession == 1 and not na(entryTime) and time_close >= entryTime + HOLD_HOURS * HOUR_MS
nyMidnightExitDue = strategy.position_size > 0 and activeSession == 2 and newDay
timeExitDue = asiaTimeExitDue or nyMidnightExitDue
timeExitThisBar = timeExitDue and not stopExitThisBar
profitableTimeExitThisBar = timeExitThisBar and close > strategy.position_avg_price
dateRangeExitDue = closeAtEndInput and dateRangeEnded and strategy.position_size > 0
dateRangeExitThisBar = dateRangeExitDue and not timeExitDue and not stopExitThisBar

if timeExitThisBar
    strategy.cancel("Asia SL")
    strategy.cancel("NY SL")
    strategy.close(activeEntryId, comment = activeSession == 2 ? "NY UTC daily exit" : "24h time exit", immediately = nyMidnightExitDue)
else if dateRangeExitThisBar
    strategy.cancel("Asia SL")
    strategy.cancel("NY SL")
    strategy.close(activeEntryId, comment = "Date range exit")

if stopExitThisBar or timeExitThisBar or dateRangeExitThisBar
    if activeSession == 1 and not na(triggeredAsiaOpenLine)
        line.set_xy2(triggeredAsiaOpenLine, time_close, asiaOpen)
        triggeredAsiaOpenLine := na
    if activeSession == 2 and not na(triggeredNyOpenLine)
        line.set_xy2(triggeredNyOpenLine, time_close, nyOpen)
        triggeredNyOpenLine := na

positionClosedThisBar = strategy.position_size == 0 and strategy.position_size[1] > 0
if positionClosedThisBar
    entryTime := na
    activeSession := 0
    activeEntryId := ""
    activeStopPrice := na

// --- Entry and exit markers ---
plotshape(asiaTrigger, title = "Asia entry signal", style = shape.triangleup, location = location.belowbar, color = #089981, text = "A", textcolor = chart.fg_color, size = size.tiny)
plotshape(nyTrigger, title = "NY entry signal", style = shape.triangleup, location = location.belowbar, color = #f59e0b, text = "N", textcolor = chart.fg_color, size = size.tiny)
plotshape(stopExitThisBar, title = "Stop-loss exit", style = shape.triangledown, location = location.abovebar, color = #f23645, text = "SL", textcolor = chart.fg_color, size = size.tiny)
plotshape(profitableTimeExitThisBar, title = "Profit exit", style = shape.triangledown, location = location.abovebar, color = #089981, text = "TP", textcolor = chart.fg_color, size = size.tiny)
plotshape(timeExitThisBar and not profitableTimeExitThisBar, title = "Time exit", style = shape.triangledown, location = location.abovebar, color = #f59e0b, text = "X", textcolor = chart.fg_color, size = size.tiny)

// --- Native strategy statistics ---
closedTrades = strategy.closedtrades
rawSignals = asiaRawSignalCount + nyRawSignalCount
totalSignals = asiaSignalCount + nySignalCount
skippedVolumeSignals = asiaSkippedVolumeCount + nySkippedVolumeCount
winRate = closedTrades > 0 ? 100.0 * strategy.wintrades / closedTrades : na
avgTrade = closedTrades > 0 ? strategy.netprofit / closedTrades : na
netReturn = 100.0 * strategy.netprofit / INITIAL_CAPITAL
profitFactor = strategy.grossloss != 0.0 ? strategy.grossprofit / math.abs(strategy.grossloss) : na

var int periodATradeCount = 0
var int periodAWins = 0
var int periodBTradeCount = 0
var int periodBWins = 0
periodStatsNeedUpdate = barstate.isfirst or strategy.closedtrades != strategy.closedtrades[1] or barstate.islast
if periodStatsNeedUpdate
    periodATradeCount := calculatePeriodTradeCount(PERIOD_A_START, PERIOD_A_END)
    periodAWins := calculatePeriodWinCount(PERIOD_A_START, PERIOD_A_END)
    periodBTradeCount := calculatePeriodTradeCount(PERIOD_B_START, PERIOD_B_END)
    periodBWins := calculatePeriodWinCount(PERIOD_B_START, PERIOD_B_END)
periodAWinRate = periodATradeCount > 0 ? 100.0 * periodAWins / periodATradeCount : na
periodBWinRate = periodBTradeCount > 0 ? 100.0 * periodBWins / periodBTradeCount : na
selectedMatrixIndex = retraceThresholdInput == 1.5 ? 0 : retraceThresholdInput == 2.0 ? 1 : retraceThresholdInput == 2.5 ? 2 : 3
matrixClosed15 = selectedMatrixIndex == 0 ? closedTrades : array.get(simClosedCountArray, 0)
matrixClosed20 = selectedMatrixIndex == 1 ? closedTrades : array.get(simClosedCountArray, 1)
matrixClosed25 = selectedMatrixIndex == 2 ? closedTrades : array.get(simClosedCountArray, 2)
matrixClosed30 = selectedMatrixIndex == 3 ? closedTrades : array.get(simClosedCountArray, 3)
matrixWins15 = selectedMatrixIndex == 0 ? strategy.wintrades : array.get(simWinCountArray, 0)
matrixWins20 = selectedMatrixIndex == 1 ? strategy.wintrades : array.get(simWinCountArray, 1)
matrixWins25 = selectedMatrixIndex == 2 ? strategy.wintrades : array.get(simWinCountArray, 2)
matrixWins30 = selectedMatrixIndex == 3 ? strategy.wintrades : array.get(simWinCountArray, 3)
matrixPnl15 = selectedMatrixIndex == 0 ? strategy.netprofit : array.get(simClosedPnlArray, 0)
matrixPnl20 = selectedMatrixIndex == 1 ? strategy.netprofit : array.get(simClosedPnlArray, 1)
matrixPnl25 = selectedMatrixIndex == 2 ? strategy.netprofit : array.get(simClosedPnlArray, 2)
matrixPnl30 = selectedMatrixIndex == 3 ? strategy.netprofit : array.get(simClosedPnlArray, 3)

var table statsTable = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 18, bgcolor = color.new(chart.bg_color, 5), frame_color = color.new(chart.fg_color, 70), frame_width = 1)
var table periodTable = table.new(position.top_left, 2, 4, bgcolor = color.new(chart.bg_color, 5), frame_color = color.new(chart.fg_color, 70), frame_width = 1)
var table matrixTable = table.new(position.bottom_left, 7, 5, bgcolor = color.new(chart.bg_color, 5), frame_color = color.new(chart.fg_color, 70), frame_width = 1)

if barstate.islast and showStatsInput
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 0, "Asia + NY strategy", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small, bgcolor = color.new(#5b9cf6, 75))
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 0, "Native Strategy Tester", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small, bgcolor = color.new(#5b9cf6, 75))
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 1, "Entry", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 1, "+" + str.tostring(gainPctInput, "#.##") + "% within first " + str.tostring(measurementHoursInput) + "h + volume", text_color = #089981, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 2, "Exit", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 2, "Asia 24h / NY UTC midnight / 2% SL", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 3, "Raw signals", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 3, str.tostring(rawSignals), text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 4, "Eligible signals", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 4, str.tostring(totalSignals), text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 5, "Skipped by volume", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 5, str.tostring(skippedVolumeSignals), text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 6, "Asia / NY eligible", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 6, str.tostring(asiaSignalCount) + " / " + str.tostring(nySignalCount), text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 7, "Closed trades", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 7, str.tostring(closedTrades), text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 8, "Win rate", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 8, na(winRate) ? "n/a" : str.tostring(winRate, "#.##") + "%", text_color = winRate >= 50.0 ? #089981 : #f23645, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 9, "Net PnL", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 9, str.tostring(strategy.netprofit, "#,##0.##"), text_color = strategy.netprofit >= 0.0 ? #089981 : #f23645, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 10, "Net return", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 10, str.tostring(netReturn, "#.##") + "%", text_color = netReturn >= 0.0 ? #089981 : #f23645, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 11, "Avg trade", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 1, 11, na(avgTrade) ? "n/a" : str.tostring(avgTrade, "#,##0.##"), text_color = avgTrade >= 0.0 ? #089981 : #f23645, text_size = size.small)
    table.cell(statsTable, 0, 12, "Profit factor", text_color = chart.fg_color, text_size = size.small)
